# Named excited states of H2 in the Tamm-Dancoff approximation: the lowest root at
# one rung (protocol 1e-4) plus the static alpha_zz the same run gives, the
# named twin of src/examples/qc/response_h2_es_tda (D-025). The stage's
# maxiter caps the bundle's rung and the dipole leg alike (one cap, B5);
# the engine's warmup length and subspace size are its defaults, so the
# unnamed deck to compare with writes no excited.guess_max_iter,
# excited.maxsub or excited.maxiter and sets maxiter 20.
# Run: madqc named_h2_es_tda.in --prefix=H2-es-tda
# The response checkpoint publishes the bundle and plans it on --continue
# (D-025).
molecule H2
  units angstrom
  eprec 1e-5
  H 0.0 0.0 -0.37
  H 0.0 0.0 0.37
end

moldft gs
  molecule H2
  xc hf
  L 100
  localize canon
  protocol [1e-4]
  dconv 1e-4
  maxiter 30
  requested_properties [energy, dipole]
end

molresponse excited
  reference gs
  protocol [1e-4]
  dconv 1e-4
  maxiter 20
  requested_properties [excited_states, polarizability]
  excited_states.roots 1
  excited_states.method tda
  polarizability.frequencies [0.0, 0.02]
  polarizability.frequency_units au
  polarizability.components [zz]
end
